purpose: Minimum evidence request for computing a historical absolute manager/Runner ordinal; not a product API or implementation schema.
per_run_fields: hash-bound run identity and task generation
module basename and image SHA-256 per sequence entry
audio_filter getter count per sequence entry
DDP Atmos entry matched by image SHA-256
absolute_ordinal_formula: sum(audio_filter getter counts for entries before the DDP Atmos entry) + DDP Atmos local factory index
data_policy: Metadata only: module identity/order/counts. No media, PCM, payload, bitstream, license, or key contents.
